name: UFC GYM - MBZ | Abu Dhabi
review_text:
I would like to share my honest feedback about my experience at your gym. The facility itself is spacious and well-equipped, and I really appreciate the variety of machines and the overall cleanliness of the place.

However, I faced some issues during my visits. The trainers often prioritize their personal clients over regular members. For example, on one occasion, I was using a machine when a trainer insisted that I stop so his client could use it. Also, when I asked for guidance about using certain machines, I didn’t receive much help unless I joined a paid training program.

Another inconvenience is the Wi-Fi access process. Each time I come to the gym, I have to request a paper password to connect, which is not very practical.

Because of these issues, I can’t give a high rating, but I truly hope my feedback helps improve the overall experience for all members.

name: UFC GYM - MBZ | Abu Dhabi
review_text:
I've been a member of UFC for three years, but over the past year, it has become increasingly difficult to attend consistently. I have already submitted a formal complaint regarding the gym equipment, yet the issues persist.
The treadmill gives electric shocks, and the stair machine randomly speeds up and slows down, making it unsafe. The yoga mats are worn out, dirty, and have an unpleasant odor. There are only two cable ropes available for around 30 people during peak hours, and just one foam bar for the entire gym. The treadmills are positioned directly in front of the mirrors, which is inconvenient. Additionally, essential equipment such as leg grips, stretch belts, and properly stored skipping ropes are missing—the skipping rope is simply thrown into an empty cardboard box.

Most concerningly, there are no water dispensers, which is surprising since this is the first gym I’ve ever been to that lacks such a basic necessity. I am extremely disappointed with the current state of the gym and the decline in its quality. To be fair enough the coaches Ayman and Hamdi are very helpful and the Receptionist is very welcoming.
